chunks.arabic_text: وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلَامُ :

translations.en: Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' asked al-Rida عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ اَلصَّبِيَّةِ يُزَوِّجُهَا أَبُوهَا ثُمَّ يَمُوتُ وَ هِيَ صَغِيرَةٌ ثُمَّ تَكْبَرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا زَوْجُهَا أَ يَجُوزُ عَلَيْهَا اَلتَّزْوِيجُ أَمِ اَلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْهَا

translations.en: About a young girl whom her father marries off, then he dies while she is still young; then she grows older before her husband consummates the marriage with her: is that marriage binding upon her, or is the matter up to her?
So he عليه السلام said: "The marriage conducted by her father is valid and binding upon her."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a minor girl married by her father. Imam al-Rida عليه السلام states that the father's marriage arrangement remains valid for her even if she reaches maturity before consummation. The narration relates to guardianship and marriage_family_law in Shia fiqh.
en.seo_question: Is a marriage arranged by a father for his minor daughter valid after she reaches maturity?

key_terms.اَلصَّبِيَّةِ: a young girl or minor female
key_terms.تَكْبَرُ: she reaches an older age or maturity
key_terms.اَلتَّزْوِيجُ: the marriage arrangement or contracting of marriage
key_terms.تَزْوِيجُ أَبِيهَا: the marriage conducted by her father
